document_requirements.label: Photo ID
document_requirements.helper_text_en: Driver's license, state ID card, passport, military ID, or tribal ID. CalFresh accepts any government-issued photo ID.
document_requirements.helper_text_es: Licencia de conducir, tarjeta de identificación estatal, pasaporte, identificación militar o tribal. CalFresh acepta cualquier identificación con foto emitida por el gobierno.

document_requirements.label: Recent pay stub
document_requirements.helper_text_en: Your most recent pay stub or an employer letter showing your current wages and hours.
document_requirements.helper_text_es: Su talón de pago más reciente o una carta del empleador que muestre su salario y horas actuales.

document_requirements.label: Bank or financial account statement
document_requirements.helper_text_en: Most recent statement for checking, savings, or other accounts showing current balances.
document_requirements.helper_text_es: Estado de cuenta más reciente de cuentas corrientes, de ahorros u otras, que muestre los saldos actuales.
document_requirements.review_note: TODO: confirm with counsel — CA BBCE households may not need asset verification; applicability depends on BBCE vs. standard track.

document_requirements.label: Benefit award letter
document_requirements.helper_text_en: Official award letter from Social Security, SSI, unemployment, or other benefit programs showing your monthly payment amount.
document_requirements.helper_text_es: Carta oficial de adjudicación del Seguro Social, SSI, desempleo u otros programas de beneficios que muestre el monto de su pago mensual.
document_requirements.review_note: TODO: confirm with counsel — verify whether benefit_letter and bank_statement are both required, or one-or-the-other, for unearned income.

document_requirements.label: Proof of address
document_requirements.helper_text_en: Lease or rental agreement, mortgage statement, or a letter from your landlord confirming your current address.
document_requirements.helper_text_es: Contrato de arrendamiento, estado de cuenta hipotecario, o carta de su arrendador que confirme su dirección actual.
document_requirements.review_note: TODO: confirm with counsel — CA may accept a utility bill or a signed statement in lieu of a lease for homeless households; also confirm whether proof of address is required for non-shelter-claiming households.

document_requirements.label: Utility bill
document_requirements.helper_text_en: Recent gas, electric, heating oil, or water bill. Used to verify your utility costs for the shelter deduction.
document_requirements.helper_text_es: Factura reciente de gas, electricidad, combustible para calefacción o agua. Se usa para verificar sus costos de servicios públicos para la deducción de vivienda.
